Hippocampal proteome after ACT chemotherapy: ACT vs Sham

McElroy et al. (2020) Int. J. Mol. Sci., supplementary file ijms-730741 (raw iBAQ) — independent re-analysis

2026-11-14

1 Design

  • Tissue / model: mouse hippocampus; ACT = doxorubicin + cyclophosphamide + paclitaxel.
  • Contrast: ACT vs Sham, n = 4 per group. Positive log2FC = higher in ACT. MnBuOE groups are excluded on purpose (chemotherapy effect only).
  • Input: raw MaxQuant iBAQ from Table S1 (5514 protein groups). Authors’ normalized values and statistics are not used.

2 Methods

Step Setting
Missing values iBAQ = 0 treated as missing
Filter ≥ 3 valid values in at least one group → 5200 proteins
Transformation / normalization log2, median centering per sample
Imputation MinProb-like: N(mean − 1.8 SD, 0.3 SD) per sample, seed 42
Model limma ~ 0 + group + batch (batch = replicate pair 1–2 vs 3–4), eBayes(trend = TRUE)
Significance BH FDR < 0.05; if nothing passes, unadjusted P < 0.01; always |log2FC| > 0.5
Sensitivity same model without imputation (limma handles NAs)
Enrichment GSEA (GO ALL, KEGG) on signed −log10(P); ORA (GO BP) of up/down sets vs the identified proteome; gene sets 10–500, adj. P < 0.05

3 Quality control

Missing values per sample: Sham_1=1059; Sham_2=1190; Sham_3=208; Sham_4=276; ACT_1=967; ACT_2=575; ACT_3=215; ACT_4=320.

Variance explained by the PCs: PC1=34%; PC2=19%; PC3=14.7%; PC4=12%. Replicates 1–2 and 3–4 differ in depth; the replicate pair is modeled as a batch factor.

4 Differential abundance

Criterion used in this run: unadjusted P < 0.01 and |log2FC| > 0.5 → 29 up and 9 down in ACT (0 proteins pass FDR < 0.05 without the fold-change filter).

robust = the call holds in the analysis without imputation (same direction and cutoffs). miss Sham / miss ACT = replicates without a quantification (imputed values).

4.2 Sensitivity to imputation

20 of 38 calls are robust without imputation; correlation of log2FC with vs without imputation: r = 0.655. Calls that depend on imputation are usually presence/absence patterns (protein missing in most replicates of one group) rather than quantitative changes.

6 Reproducibility

Parameters (config/config.yaml):

# Parameters for the ACT vs Sham hippocampal proteomics analysis.
# Paths are relative to the project root (proteomics/).

data:
  raw_xlsx: data/ijms-730741-SI.xlsx     # supplementary file (Table S1, raw iBAQ)
  processed: data/processed.csv          # output of scripts/prepare.sh, input of the R script

results_dir: results                     # CSV tables
plots_dir: plots                         # PDF + PNG figures
reports_dir: reports                     # HTML report

seed: 42                                 # imputation and GSEA permutations

preprocessing:
  min_valid_per_group: 3                 # keep proteins quantified in >= n replicates of some group
  impute_shift: 1.8                      # MinProb: mean shift (in SD) of the imputation distribution
  impute_width: 0.3                      # MinProb: width (in SD) of the imputation distribution

de:
  fdr_cutoff: 0.05                       # BH FDR, used if any protein passes it
  nominal_cutoff: 0.01                   # unadjusted P, fallback when nothing passes FDR
  logfc_cutoff: 0.5                      # |log2FC|

enrichment:
  min_gs_size: 10
  max_gs_size: 500
  pvalue_cutoff: 0.05                    # BH-adjusted, GSEA and ORA
  run_kegg: true                         # needs internet access to rest.kegg.jp
